Page number top right. No running head, catchword or signature. Show-through from the other side appears faintly in the margins and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Ioincte à la theologie La muse d'elle regie On voit souuent se lier Puis tenant la mort bridee De deux chapeaux girlandee Son nom se fait publier.
Puisse ainsi dessous noftre Ource La tienne prendre sa course Tenant au poin le flambeau Que celui qui Dieu n'adore Na congnu(marchant encore) Aux yeux vn mortel bandeau.

page.notes: The printer's ornament below the text is a woodcut device showing a grotesque mask within scrollwork, with pendant rings; it is not transcribed as text. Printed reading "Ource" is kept as set. The ligature in "Ioincte" is read as ct. Word "poin" is as printed (probably "poing", "poignant"); copied as seen.
